article.title: I hate perfume
article.excerpt: I really, really do. All perfume, and yes that means yours too. But I loved the book Perfumes: The Guide , by Luca Turin and Tania Sanchez. If you are rating this book along the single dimension of how skillfully it informs the reader, it is one of the best non-fiction books I have read, ever.
